question:
A hollow cylindrical pipe has an outer radius of 7 cm and an inner radius of 5 cm. If the pipe is 42 cm long and made of metal with a density of 5 g/cm³, what is the mass of the pipe?

 ({Use } pi = (22)/(7) { and Density } = frac{{Mass}}{{Volume}})
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Volume of metal = πh(R² − r²)

= (22/7) × 42 × (49 − 25)

= (22/7) × 42 × 24 = 3168 cm³

Mass = Density × Volume = 5 × 3168 = 15840 g

**∴ Answer = 15.84 kg**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Outer radius = 7 cm, Inner radius = 5 cm

Height = 42 cm, Density = 5 g/cm³

**Formula used:**

Volume of hollow cylinder = πh(R² − r²)

Mass = Density × Volume

**Calculation:**

⇒ Volume = (22/7) × 42 × (7² − 5²)

⇒ = (22/7) × 42 × (49 − 25)

⇒ = (22/7) × 42 × 24

⇒ = 3168 cm³

⇒ Mass = 5 × 3168 = 15840 g

**∴ The correct answer is **15.84 kg.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Hollow Cylinder

Volume = πh(R² − r²)

Density Formula

Density = Mass / Volume

Units

Ensure consistent units (cm, g)

Key Insight

Subtract inner volume from outer volume
